Our systems help the largest financial institutions improve their digital payment experience and drive financial inclusion across the country. ClickHouse is a core part of our analytics stack and is used heavily for Petabyte Scale,high-volume observability workloads. When it degrades, our customers see it immediately. We are looking for someone to own it. Not to babysit dashboards, but to hold real responsibility for schema design, performance, recoverability, and the operational tooling that keeps the cluster running. What we're optimizing for is depth in ClickHouse itself — the storage engine, the failure modes,the schema decisions that determine whether a query takes 200ms or 40 seconds. That is the part that's hard to teach. Our clusters run on Kubernetes, managed by the ClickHouse operator. If you have already run stateful workloads there, great — you'll be productive faster. If you haven't, that's learnable on the job, and you'll have a platform team alongside you who knows that layer well. If that sounds like the interesting part of the job rather than the scary part, we should talk. Roles & Responsibilities Cluster operations Own capacity planning and scaling across shards and replicas, including resharding work. Operate replication reliably, and diagnose and recover from replication and metadata failures under time pressure. Build and rehearse backup and disaster recovery with documented RTO/RPO and restore drills that actually get executed. Operate ClickHouse Keeper: quorum health, ensemble scaling, and recovery when consensus is lost. Harden the platform: users, roles, quotas, row policies, settings constraints, TLS, and secrets management. Schema and query design Design and review schemas for query performance, storage efficiency, and long-term maintainability. Partner with application engineers before code ships. Most ClickHouse performance problems are schema decisions made six months earlier, and we'd rather catch them at review time. Tune query and ingest performance across the cluster, and set resource limits that keep workloads isolated from each other. Process, automation, and support Build the systems that make cluster operations repeatable: runbooks, automated health checks, remediation tooling, and diagnostic scripts that turn recurring incidents into routine, low-skill fixes. Build observability that catches problems early: dashboards over system.* tables and pod/node metrics, alert thresholds that mean something, and a clean alert-to-runbook mapping. Serve as L3 escalation for the customer-facing support team — triage incoming issues, and write self-serve tooling so routine cases never reach you. Lead incident response for database-layer outages, write the postmortems, and maintain the runbooks. Documentation is part of the deliverable, not an afterthought. Running ClickHouse on Kubernetes You'll grow into this if it's new to you — but it will become part of the job. Own the deployment lifecycle: operator-managed cluster definitions, Helm values, version upgrades, and rolling restarts across a multi-replica StatefulSet without data loss or split-brain — including the awkward parts, like immutable field changes, PVC retention, and rollback when an upgrade fails partway through. Manage persistent storage and the pod/node layer for a database workload: storage classes and volume expansion, resource requests and limits, anti-affinity and topology spread, PodDisruptionBudgets, probes, and termination grace periods long enough for a clean shutdown. Mandatory Skills 5+ years of overall experience (3+ years of hands-on ClickHouse in production — running and operating it, not just querying it). Demonstrated experience building operational systems, not just operating them. You have designed and shipped runbooks, automated remediation tooling, alerting frameworks, or support processes that other engineers depend on — and you can point to what measurably changed as a result: fewer pages, faster recovery, escalations that stopped reaching you. Deep understanding of the ClickHouse storage engine: parts and merges, primary vs. skipping indexes, partitioning trade-offs, and what happens when Keeper metadata and on-disk state disagree. Demonstrated experience recovering a ClickHouse cluster from a real failure. We will ask you to walk us through one. Strong SQL and query optimization skills, with the ability to explain why a query is slow rather than making it faster by trial and error. Solid Linux fundamentals — you can debug inside a container and at the node level: process and memory behavior, filesystem and I/O diagnostics, and network troubleshooting. Scripting proficiency in Go or Python and/or Bash for automation and operational tooling. Clear written communication — you can explain a failure to an engineer, a support rep, and a customer-facing stakeholder without rewriting it three times

review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Integration Manager & Technical Support Specialist based in South Africa. This is a hands-on technical support and integration role focused on ensuring merchants are fully configured, technically validated, and ready for successful production launches. You will work at the intersection of merchant onboarding, payment integrations, troubleshooting, and platform reliability within a fast-moving fintech and crypto environment. The role involves configuring payment methods and routing, validating APIs, investigating transaction issues, and identifying the root causes of technical incidents. You will collaborate closely with international merchants and Engineering teams to resolve complex issues and ensure smooth Go-Live experiences. Use monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana to trace transaction errors and investigate issues across technical systems. Replicate and isolate reported bugs to determine whether an issue originates on the merchant side or within the platform. You understand client-server architecture, REST APIs, and JSON structures and can apply this knowledge to integration troubleshooting. You are comfortable using Postman to validate API requests, investigate responses, and troubleshoot integration issues. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform root-cause analysis and develop clear remediation plans under time constraints. You have exceptional attention to detail and understand the importance of precision when managing technical configurations, access credentials, payment settings, and production environments. You are proactive and self-directed, taking ownership of merchant issues rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions. You can quickly learn new technical documentation, systems, workflows, and product requirements in a rapidly evolving environment. You remain calm and effective under pressure and are comfortable handling incidents where accuracy and response time are critical. You have fluent Russian language skills and upper-intermediate to advanced English proficiency, approximately B2/C1, enabling you to communicate complex technical matters effectively with international merchants and colleagues. You can write concise incident reports and present technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are committed to continuous learning and are motivated by opportunities to develop toward senior SRE, product, or engineering responsibilities. review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Integration Manager & Technical Support Specialist based in Saudi Arabia. This is a hands-on technical support and integration role focused on ensuring merchants are fully configured, technically validated, and ready for successful production launches. You will work at the intersection of merchant onboarding, payment integrations, troubleshooting, and platform reliability within a fast-moving fintech and crypto environment. The role involves configuring payment methods and routing, validating APIs, investigating transaction issues, and identifying the root causes of technical incidents. You will collaborate closely with international merchants and Engineering teams to resolve complex issues and ensure smooth Go-Live experiences. With significant ownership over production readiness, your work will directly contribute to platform reliability and merchant success. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically curious support professional who enjoys solving challenging problems and working with modern financial infrastructure. Accountabilities Lead technical merchant onboarding by configuring integrations, payment routing, and payment methods across PSP, on/off-ramp, and card solutions. Manage API access and system environments, including issuing API keys and ensuring configurations are correctly established for production readiness. Validate API requests and troubleshoot integration issues using tools such as Postman, identifying configuration or technical problems before merchants go live. Investigate transaction incidents by analyzing JSON payloads, SQL queries, system logs, and monitoring data to identify root causes and determine appropriate remediation. Use monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana to trace transaction errors and investigate issues across technical systems. Replicate and isolate reported bugs to determine whether an issue originates on the merchant side or within the platform. Triage technical issues and provide clear, actionable escalations to Engineering when deeper investigation or product fixes are required. Support the final technical verification and production readiness process for merchants, ensuring configurations and integrations meet the required standards before launch. Communicate technical findings clearly to international merchants and internal stakeholders, translating complex technical issues into understandable explanations and actionable next steps. Prepare concise incident reports and technical findings while maintaining accurate documentation throughout troubleshooting and resolution processes. Remain accountable for issues through resolution, prioritizing accuracy, responsiveness, and reliable execution in time-sensitive situations. Requirements You have at least 1 year of experience in L2/L3 technical support or a strong track record as a Senior Support Agent or Support Manager, ideally within fintech, crypto, payments, or a related technology environment. You have hands-on experience working with system logs and monitoring tools and can trace transaction errors to identify their underlying causes. You understand client-server architecture, REST APIs, and JSON structures and can apply this knowledge to integration troubleshooting. You are comfortable using Postman to validate API requests, investigate responses, and troubleshoot integration issues. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform root-cause analysis and develop clear remediation plans under time constraints. You have exceptional attention to detail and understand the importance of precision when managing technical configurations, access credentials, payment settings, and production environments. You are proactive and self-directed, taking ownership of merchant issues rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions. You can quickly learn new technical documentation, systems, workflows, and product requirements in a rapidly evolving environment. You remain calm and effective under pressure and are comfortable handling incidents where accuracy and response time are critical. You have fluent Russian language skills and upper-intermediate to advanced English proficiency, approximately B2/C1, enabling you to communicate complex technical matters effectively with international merchants and colleagues. You can write concise incident reports and present technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are committed to continuous learning and are motivated by opportunities to develop toward senior SRE, product, or engineering responsibilities. Benefits Fully remote work within an agile and international team. Competitive salary based on your experience, skills, and individual contribution, with salary expectations requested in USDC. Career progression opportunities toward senior SRE, product, or engineering roles. Significant ownership and direct impact on platform reliability, merchant success, and production readiness. Opportunity to work at the intersection of fintech, cryptocurrency, payments, APIs, and digital financial infrastructure. Collaborative and transparent working environment that encourages open communication, experimentation, and measurable impact. Opportunity to work on technically challenging problems while continuously developing your technical and analytical skills.
